# Catalogue refresh fixtures

The [10 mm bore plate](../mesh-position/plate-10.stl) is the initial
catalogue input. `plate-12.stl` is its locally generated OpenSCAD counterpart
with a 12 mm through-hole. Both use millimetres and share the 60 × 40 × 10 mm
outer dimensions and the (17, 23) mm hole centre. The 12 mm bore mesh retains its
original bytes. SHA-256:
`31b2e61e1ba222f953e159f70bba917f6da1bf3b60331f6fe13989575034a3f5`.

`assembly-view.dxf` is a repository-authored R12 DXF containing one line and
no drawing unit declaration. The catalogue test supplies no unit metadata
for this drawing.
